correctness.rationale: The cited environmental equations give logit derivatives (1+theta_1)x-1, (1+theta_2)y-1 and (1+theta_12)(x+y)/2-1. The coefficient choices cancel both strategy variables exactly, leaving a+b-1. The logistic coordinate factors and bounded vector field give finite-time interiority and global existence. In each sign case, if d is the minimum of the three indicated boundary distances, then d^(1+a+b) is at most the product of their respective powers; the odds identity bounds the product since its complementary product is at most one. This gives the stated rate and confines omega-limits to the appropriate closed union, not to a specified face. Translation invariance of the pushed-forward probability under any fixed nonzero time step contradicts equal masses on a countable partition of disjoint translates; the proof requires no compact support. The resonance is the stated harmonic mean. At resonance the proposed admissible payoffs give G=1-2n; evaluating at the two within-community strategy thresholds and three environmental halves makes all five derivatives vanish. The given one-parameter equilibrium variant also checks. Independently rederived the identities and both Figure 8 anchors, sigma=7/8 and 55/728. Inspected the frozen verification script and reproducibility notes without executing the upload; the recorded numerical trajectories are illustrative, not proof of the global conclusion.
